description: Export a specific Figma node as SVG and optionally save it

inline.description: Return the full SVG markup in the response (structuredContent.svg) instead of a 500-char preview. Default false locally, always true on a hosted server.

nodeId.description: Node ID to export as SVG

outputDir.description: Output directory for saved SVGs (default: $FIGMA_PROXY_SVG_DIR or ./exported-svgs relative to the server working directory; pass an absolute path to be explicit)

save.description: Whether to save the SVG to disk (default: false)

name: export_svg
